category_fields.name: category_fields
category_fields.value: char_length(btrim("categories"."name")) between 1 and 160 and ("categories"."color" is null or "categories"."color" ~ '^#[0-9a-fA-F]{6}$') and char_length("categories"."icon")<=40

cardio_bounds.name: cardio_bounds
cardio_bounds.value: "cardio_activities"."activity_type" in ('run','walk','swim','cycle','skip','other') and isfinite("cardio_activities"."started_at") and "cardio_activities"."duration_seconds"<=2678400 and "cardio_activities"."distance_meters"<=10000000 and char_length(btrim("cardio_activities"."title")) between 1 and 160 and char_length("cardio_activities"."notes")<=4000

exercise_metadata.name: exercise_metadata
exercise_metadata.value: cardinality("exercises"."equipment")<=10 and "exercises"."equipment" <@ ARRAY['Barbell','Dumbbells','Cable','Machine','Bodyweight','Bench','Kettlebell','Resistance band','Pull-up bar','Other']::text[] and cardinality("exercises"."muscles")<=6 and "exercises"."muscles" <@ ARRAY['Chest','Back','Shoulders','Arms','Legs','Core']::text[]

strength_plans_fields.name: strength_plans_fields
strength_plans_fields.value: "strength_plans"."version">0 and char_length(btrim("strength_plans"."title")) between 1 and 160 and char_length("strength_plans"."notes")<=4000 and "strength_plans"."kind" in ('workout','scheduled') and jsonb_typeof("strength_plans"."exercises")='array' and jsonb_array_length("strength_plans"."exercises") between (case when "strength_plans"."is_draft" then 0 else 1 end) and 50 and (not "strength_plans"."is_draft" or "strength_plans"."kind"='workout') and ("strength_plans"."kind"='scheduled' or ("strength_plans"."time_block_id" is null and "strength_plans"."session_id" is null))

set_positive_values.name: set_positive_values
set_positive_values.value: (not "strength_sets"."completed" or "strength_sets"."reps" is not null or "strength_sets"."duration_seconds" is not null or "strength_sets"."distance_meters" is not null or "strength_sets"."laps" is not null) and ("strength_sets"."distance_meters" is null or ("strength_sets"."distance_meters" > 0 and "strength_sets"."distance_meters" <= 10000000)) and ("strength_sets"."target_distance_meters" is null or ("strength_sets"."target_distance_meters" > 0 and "strength_sets"."target_distance_meters" <= 10000000)) and ("strength_sets"."laps" is null or "strength_sets"."laps" between 1 and 10000) and ("strength_sets"."target_laps" is null or "strength_sets"."target_laps" between 1 and 10000) and not ("strength_sets"."completed" and "strength_sets"."skipped") and ("strength_sets"."target_reps" is null or "strength_sets"."target_reps" between 1 and 10000) and ("strength_sets"."target_weight_kg" is null or "strength_sets"."target_weight_kg" between 0 and 2000) and ("strength_sets"."target_duration_seconds" is null or "strength_sets"."target_duration_seconds" between 1 and 86400) and ("strength_sets"."rest_seconds" is null or "strength_sets"."rest_seconds" between 0 and 3600) and ("strength_sets"."reps" is null or "strength_sets"."reps">0) and ("strength_sets"."duration_seconds" is null or "strength_sets"."duration_seconds">0) and ("strength_sets"."weight_kg" is null or "strength_sets"."weight_kg">=0)

workout_bounds.name: workout_bounds
workout_bounds.value: isfinite("strength_workouts"."started_at") and isfinite("strength_workouts"."ended_at") and "strength_workouts"."ended_at"-"strength_workouts"."started_at"<=interval '31 days' and char_length(btrim("strength_workouts"."title")) between 1 and 160 and char_length("strength_workouts"."notes")<=4000

workout_exercise_fields.name: workout_exercise_fields
workout_exercise_fields.value: "strength_workout_exercises"."position" between 0 and 49 and char_length(btrim("strength_workout_exercises"."exercise_name_snapshot")) between 1 and 160 and char_length("strength_workout_exercises"."notes")<=4000

program_occurrence_fields.name: program_occurrence_fields
program_occurrence_fields.value: "training_program_occurrences"."version">0 and isfinite("training_program_occurrences"."created_at") and isfinite("training_program_occurrences"."updated_at") and ("training_program_occurrences"."skipped_at" is null or isfinite("training_program_occurrences"."skipped_at")) and ("training_program_occurrences"."planned_date" is null or isfinite("training_program_occurrences"."planned_date")) and "training_program_occurrences"."sequence" between 0 and 1000000 and "training_program_occurrences"."cycle" between 1 and 1000001 and "training_program_occurrences"."position" between 0 and 19 and char_length(btrim("training_program_occurrences"."workout_title_snapshot")) between 1 and 160

training_program_fields.name: training_program_fields
training_program_fields.value: "training_programs"."version">0 and isfinite("training_programs"."created_at") and isfinite("training_programs"."updated_at") and isfinite("training_programs"."start_date") and char_length(btrim("training_programs"."title")) between 1 and 160 and char_length("training_programs"."notes")<=4000 and cardinality("training_programs"."training_days")<=7 and "training_programs"."training_days" <@ ARRAY[0,1,2,3,4,5,6]::integer[] and jsonb_typeof("training_programs"."steps")='array' and jsonb_array_length("training_programs"."steps") between 1 and 20

goal_status.name: goal_status
goal_status.value: "goals"."status" in ('active','completed','paused','archived') and (("goals"."status"='completed') = ("goals"."completed_at" is not null)) and isfinite("goals"."completed_at") and isfinite("goals"."target_date")

preferences_values.name: preferences_values
preferences_values.value: "preferences"."version">0 and "preferences"."week_starts_on" in (0,1) and "preferences"."weight_unit" in ('kg','lb') and "preferences"."distance_unit" in ('km','mi') and char_length("preferences"."timezone") between 1 and 100

user_access_values.name: user_access_values
user_access_values.value: "users"."account_type" in ('user','admin') and "users"."version">0 and ("users"."account_type"='user' or "users"."suspended_at" is null)

food_entry_preparation_bounds.name: food_entry_preparation_bounds
food_entry_preparation_bounds.value: "food_entries"."kind_snapshot" in ('food','meal','recipe') and "food_entries"."yield_servings_snapshot" between 1 and 1000 and jsonb_typeof("food_entries"."ingredients_snapshot")='array' and jsonb_array_length("food_entries"."ingredients_snapshot")<=50

food_snapshot_bounds.name: food_snapshot_bounds
food_snapshot_bounds.value: char_length(btrim("food_entries"."name_snapshot")) between 1 and 160 and "food_entries"."serving_unit_snapshot" in ('g','ml','item','serving') and "food_entries"."serving_amount_snapshot">0 and "food_entries"."serving_amount_snapshot"<=100000 and "food_entries"."calories_snapshot" between 0 and 100000 and "food_entries"."protein_g_snapshot" between 0 and 100000 and "food_entries"."carbs_g_snapshot" between 0 and 100000 and "food_entries"."fat_g_snapshot" between 0 and 100000 and "food_entries"."fiber_g_snapshot" between 0 and 100000

food_preparation_bounds.name: food_preparation_bounds
food_preparation_bounds.value: "foods"."kind" in ('food','meal','recipe') and "foods"."yield_servings" between 1 and 1000 and char_length("foods"."instructions")<=4000 and jsonb_typeof("foods"."ingredients")='array' and jsonb_array_length("foods"."ingredients")<=50 and ("foods"."kind"='recipe' or "foods"."yield_servings"=1) and (("foods"."kind"='food' and jsonb_array_length("foods"."ingredients")=0) or ("foods"."kind"<>'food' and jsonb_array_length("foods"."ingredients")>0 and "foods"."serving_amount"=1 and "foods"."serving_unit"='serving'))

food_bounds.name: food_bounds
food_bounds.value: char_length(btrim("foods"."name")) between 1 and 160 and "foods"."serving_unit" in ('g','ml','item','serving') and "foods"."serving_amount"<=100000 and "foods"."calories"<=100000 and "foods"."protein_g"<=100000 and "foods"."carbs_g"<=100000 and "foods"."fat_g"<=100000 and "foods"."fiber_g"<=100000

calendar_item_series_shape.name: calendar_item_series_shape
calendar_item_series_shape.value: ("calendar_items"."series_id" is null and "calendar_items"."occurrence_date" is null and not "calendar_items"."is_exception") or ("calendar_items"."series_id" is not null and "calendar_items"."kind"='all_day' and "calendar_items"."occurrence_date" is not null and isfinite("calendar_items"."occurrence_date"))

calendar_item_fields.name: calendar_item_fields
calendar_item_fields.value: "calendar_items"."version">0 and isfinite("calendar_items"."created_at") and isfinite("calendar_items"."updated_at") and char_length(btrim("calendar_items"."title")) between 1 and 160 and char_length("calendar_items"."notes")<=4000

calendar_item_dates.name: calendar_item_dates
calendar_item_dates.value: isfinite("calendar_items"."date") and isfinite("calendar_items"."end_date") and (("calendar_items"."kind"='unscheduled' and "calendar_items"."end_date" is null) or ("calendar_items"."kind"='all_day' and "calendar_items"."date" is not null and "calendar_items"."end_date" is not null and "calendar_items"."end_date"-"calendar_items"."date" between 0 and 30))

calendar_series_fields.name: calendar_series_fields
calendar_series_fields.value: "calendar_series"."version">0 and isfinite("calendar_series"."created_at") and isfinite("calendar_series"."updated_at") and char_length(btrim("calendar_series"."title")) between 1 and 160 and char_length("calendar_series"."notes")<=4000 and char_length("calendar_series"."timezone") between 1 and 100

calendar_series_rule.name: calendar_series_rule
calendar_series_rule.value: isfinite("calendar_series"."start_date") and isfinite("calendar_series"."until_date") and "calendar_series"."until_date"-"calendar_series"."start_date" between 0 and 365 and "calendar_series"."start_minute" between 0 and 1439 and "calendar_series"."duration_minutes" between 1 and 44640 and "calendar_series"."frequency" in ('daily','weekly') and "calendar_series"."interval" between 1 and 52 and cardinality("calendar_series"."weekdays") between 1 and 7 and "calendar_series"."weekdays"<@array[0,1,2,3,4,5,6] and array_position("calendar_series"."weekdays",null) is null and cardinality("calendar_series"."excluded_dates")<=366 and array_position("calendar_series"."excluded_dates",null) is null

calendar_template_entry_fields.name: calendar_template_entry_fields
calendar_template_entry_fields.value: "calendar_template_entries"."version">0 and isfinite("calendar_template_entries"."created_at") and isfinite("calendar_template_entries"."updated_at") and char_length(btrim("calendar_template_entries"."title")) between 1 and 160 and char_length("calendar_template_entries"."notes")<=4000 and "calendar_template_entries"."day_offset" between 0 and 30

calendar_template_entry_shape.name: calendar_template_entry_shape
calendar_template_entry_shape.value: ("calendar_template_entries"."kind"='block' and "calendar_template_entries"."start_minute" is not null and "calendar_template_entries"."start_minute">=0 and "calendar_template_entries"."start_minute"<1440 and "calendar_template_entries"."duration_minutes" is not null and "calendar_template_entries"."duration_minutes">0 and "calendar_template_entries"."duration_minutes"<=44640 and "calendar_template_entries"."date_span" is null) or ("calendar_template_entries"."kind"='all_day' and "calendar_template_entries"."start_minute" is null and "calendar_template_entries"."duration_minutes" is null and "calendar_template_entries"."date_span" is not null and "calendar_template_entries"."date_span" between 1 and 31) or ("calendar_template_entries"."kind"='unscheduled' and "calendar_template_entries"."start_minute" is null and "calendar_template_entries"."duration_minutes" is null and "calendar_template_entries"."date_span" is null)

calendar_template_fields.name: calendar_template_fields
calendar_template_fields.value: "calendar_templates"."version">0 and isfinite("calendar_templates"."created_at") and isfinite("calendar_templates"."updated_at") and char_length(btrim("calendar_templates"."name")) between 1 and 160 and (("calendar_templates"."span" in ('day','week') and "calendar_templates"."range_days" is null) or ("calendar_templates"."span"='range' and "calendar_templates"."range_days" between 1 and 31))

block_series_shape.name: block_series_shape
block_series_shape.value: ("time_blocks"."series_id" is null and "time_blocks"."occurrence_date" is null and not "time_blocks"."is_exception") or ("time_blocks"."series_id" is not null and "time_blocks"."occurrence_date" is not null and isfinite("time_blocks"."occurrence_date"))

block_bounds.name: block_bounds
block_bounds.value: isfinite("time_blocks"."starts_at") and isfinite("time_blocks"."ends_at") and "time_blocks"."ends_at"-"time_blocks"."starts_at"<=interval '31 days' and char_length(btrim("time_blocks"."title")) between 1 and 160 and char_length("time_blocks"."notes")<=4000

entry_bounds.name: entry_bounds
entry_bounds.value: isfinite("time_entries"."starts_at") and isfinite("time_entries"."ends_at") and "time_entries"."ends_at"-"time_entries"."starts_at"<=interval '31 days' and char_length(btrim("time_entries"."title")) between 1 and 160

entry_source_kind.name: entry_source_kind
entry_source_kind.value: ("time_entries"."source_type"='manual' and "time_entries"."source_id" is null) or ("time_entries"."source_type" in ('strength_workout','cardio_activity') and "time_entries"."source_id" is not null)

routines_fields.name: routines_fields
routines_fields.value: "routines"."version">0 and char_length(btrim("routines"."name")) between 1 and 160 and jsonb_typeof("routines"."steps")='array' and jsonb_array_length("routines"."steps") between 1 and 50 and cardinality("routines"."checked")<=50 and "routines"."run_count">=0
